name: Nqwebasaurus
isnote: Wikipedia calls it a probable ornithomimosaur; earlier work (de Klerk et al. 2000, Forster 2009) placed it elsewhere among coelurosaurs or tetanurans.
sum: Probable ornithomimosaurian from the Early Cretaceous of South Africa, the oldest known of its kind.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: Not given in the sources used.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: de Klerk et al. 2000
